title.original: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
title.zh: DAPO：大规模的开源LLM强化学习系统
title.en: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

inclusion_reason.zh: DAPO 不仅提出优化方法，还开放基于 verl 的大规模 rollout、奖励和训练系统及数据配方，具备可复用后训练基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: DAPO goes beyond an optimization method by releasing a verl-based large-scale rollout, reward, and training system plus data recipe, providing reusable post-training infrastructure.

abstract.zh: DAPO 同时给出面向推理模型的大规模强化学习算法、基于 verl 的完整训练代码和处理后的数据，目标是让社区能够复现此前闭源的 RL 配方。
abstract.en: DAPO releases a large-scale reinforcement-learning algorithm for reasoning models together with a verl-based training stack and curated data, targeting reproducibility of previously opaque RL recipes.

problem.zh: 推理模型的核心 RL 细节通常未公开，研究者即使拥有基础模型，也难以稳定复现长链推理训练和相应基准表现。
problem.en: Core RL details for reasoning models are often withheld, so researchers struggle to reproduce stable long-chain reasoning training even when a base model is available.

approach.zh: 作者提出解耦裁剪与动态采样的策略优化方法，并总结四项支撑大规模训练稳定性的技术，将算法、代码和数据作为一个开放系统发布。
approach.en: The authors introduce policy optimization with decoupled clipping and dynamic sampling, identify four techniques needed for stable large-scale runs, and release algorithm, code, and data as one open system.

system_design.zh: 系统以 verl 编排策略模型、轨迹生成、奖励计算和参数更新，数据处理管线提供训练样本，DAPO 的采样与裁剪规则控制每轮优化。
system_design.en: The system uses verl to orchestrate policy execution, trajectory generation, reward computation, and updates; a data pipeline supplies examples while DAPO's sampling and clipping rules govern optimization.

key_results.zh: 开放实现从指定基础模型出发获得很强的数学推理表现，说明公开配方能够复现具有竞争力的大规模 RL 结果。
key_results.en: Starting from the reported base model, the open implementation reaches strong mathematical-reasoning performance, showing that a public recipe can reproduce competitive large-scale RL outcomes.

limitations.zh: 证据集中于特定基础模型和数学推理任务；四项工程技术对其他奖励、智能体交互和更大集群的适用性仍需独立复现。
limitations.en: Evidence centers on one base model and mathematical reasoning; transfer of the four engineering techniques to other rewards, interactive agents, and larger clusters needs independent replication.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.

seed_reports.context: The bibliography of this seed technical report directly cites the work; the page and identifier/title were verified against the archived PDF.
